From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime on-call headcount + offer band request

Hi Kimberly and Marcus,

Quick request: I'm asking for approval to open and extend an offer to fill one Senior Platform Engineer (Runtime - on-call rotation) headcount in Q2. This is a replacement+capacity slot: the team is currently understaffed for our expanded 24/7 rotation and the recent kernel rollout increased paging volume by ~35%.

Why this is urgent:
- Pager load & mean time to recovery (MTTR) have trended up; oncall fatigue risk impacting retention.
- We have a strong candidate in the final interview stage (internal recruiter Emma Liu has signaled early acceptance if we align offer band).
- Burden on current squad is creating delivery risk for the longer-term KV cache improvements and rollout schedule.

Proposed package & justification:
- Role: Senior Platform Engineer (Runtime) — full-time
- Recommended band: L5 upper quartile / comp band 5.3 (market-competitive for SRE/runtime with low-latency expertise)
- Base salary target: $180k - $205k; total OTE (with equity and typical bonus) ~ $230k - $260k
- Hiring manager: me (David Kim).
- Impact if we wait: 6+ weeks to fill, increased escalation costs and potential SLA misses for key accounts.

I've attached the headcount request doc and the comp-band recommendation spreadsheet. Numbers include budget delta and knot points if we need to stretch for relocation or retention signing.

Action requested:
1) Kimberly: approval on comp band and authority to extend verbal offer at the midpoint ($195k) with room to go to $205k after PeopleOps finalizes equity.
2) Marcus: confirmation that the hiring slot (Q2 runtime tranche) is available to commit against infra hiring capacity.

Thanks — if you'd like a 15-min sync I can join.

Best,
David

--
David Kim
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks David — good summary. A few clarifying Qs before I sign off: 

1) Is this strictly replacement + oncall capacity, or are we expanding the squad headcount? We need to track vs. committed hiring tranches.
2) Can you confirm comp band 5.3 maps to our current budgeted band for platform (I think some of those slots are reserved for senior infra hires)?
3) Any sign-on/relocation expected? If yes, please provide capped amounts so PeopleOps can price the offer.

If we can answer those three quickly I can approve verbally and route to PeopleOps (cc'ed Emma if needed).

-Kimberly

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Emma Liu <emma@hirefast.co>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime on-call headcount + offer band request

Kimberly — answers inline: 

1) Headcount type: replacement + capacity. This is a backfill for a recent departure (reclassification) plus a nominal +0.15 FTE to cover the expanded overnight rotation. We will charge against the Q2 runtime tranche (slot already earmarked for the infra team — Marcus can confirm).

2) Comp band alignment: band 5.3 is within the platform budget envelope but at the upper edge. If we approve at midpoint ($195k) it's neutral to plan; going to $205k requires a one-time tranche exception but is doable given urgency. See comp spreadsheet attached with delta scenarios.

3) Sign-on/relocation: candidate prefers remote but may request up to $8k relocation if they choose to move closer for the oncall cadence. Recommend capping relocation at $8k and a $10k one-time sign-on in exceptional cases. Please confirm PeopleOps limits.

We have a strong candidate (final bar-raise pair passed yesterday). Recruiter Emma is standing by for offer packaging. If we can get verbal ok today I can push the formal offer this week.

Thanks,
David

--
David Kim
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
